topic: Identify the composer of the ballet The Nutcracker
core_question: Who composed the ballet The Nutcracker? (secondary: What ship sank in 1912 after colliding with an iceberg on its maiden voyage?)
answer_summary: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, the Russian composer who wrote the ballet The Nutcracker (1892).; after the topic shift: The RMS Titanic, which sank in the North Atlantic on 15 April 1912 after striking an iceberg during its maiden voyage.
persona: skeptical and testy; using casual slang
